narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>There are no twos left, so two to the power zero is zero.
<bookmark mark='clash'/>Sixteen divided by sixteen is one, not zero. Every friend still gets a sweet.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Cancelling leaves one behind, so that bubble cannot be right.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 2 to the power 0 = 0; the 16 ÷ 16 = 1 line glows beside it; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>A power divided by itself is one, and the rule makes it the power zero.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Use six cubed divided by six cubed to find six to the power zero.
